submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.872 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over both Mixture-G1 (1.949 ns at 2mm) and Mixture-G3 (1.341 ns at 2mm). The optimization study for G2 across different gap widths (1mm: 1.026 ns, 2mm: 0.872 ns, 3mm: 1.035 ns) confirms that 2mm is the optimal gap width. Additionally, this configuration complies with the laboratory's environmental and safety policies, meeting all project requirements while delivering superior performance for the detector upgrade.
